تيامنت (form VI)
# تَيَامَنْتُ (tayāmantu) /ta.jaː.man.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَيَامَنَ (tayāmana)
# تَيَامَنْتَ (tayāmanta) /ta.jaː.man.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَيَامَنَ (tayāmana)
# تَيَامَنْتِ (tayāmanti) /ta.jaː.man.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَيَامَنَ (tayāmana)
# تَيَامَنَتْ (tayāmanat) /ta.jaː.ma.nat/: third-person fem
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
